::: {#intro}
B.Tech. student in Robotics and Autonomous Systems at Plaksha University, working
on control systems, machine learning, and IoT for urban monitoring. I also make
educational animations and computer-graphics content — some of it is on
[this YouTube playlist](https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLab2EpIGbIVd9DgnPfOMJ6ehyLLtiyCWI&si=0IHqm07wHnHPA_e1).
:::

  Built a robot- and simulator-agnostic training framework for hierarchical
